ops.title: PR 1316: honor root refusals of a tap-carry proposal
ops.description: Owner: PR #1316 implementation lane (agentic-judge-landing). Static review only; no tests run. Evidence: desk-runner.py:6972 and :6999-7005. Any standing go at the head short-circuits proposal_declined, so a root non-go answer to TAP-KEPT can be ignored and the tap carried when the finder becomes clear. Also proposal_declined discards all go-kind replies, including one naming a different PR or head, which is not a qualifying approval. Next executable step: classify the root's actual proposal response against the requested PR/head and its sequence; an unrelated or negative answer must produce TAP-NOT-CARRIED even when an older go remains. Add regressions with an outstanding finder, an older go, and a linked root refusal, plus a wrong-head go reply.

ops.text: A non-go root answer to TAP-KEPT emits TAP-NOT-CARRIED and prevents carry under an older standing go.
A go reply that does not approve the proposed PR/head is handled as a non-approving response.
